page_title: Rajendra P N - Azure Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer
summary_html: Lead Azure DevOps Engineer with 10+ years of experience in infrastructure automation, release engineering, and production operations. Engineers Azure cloud infrastructure with Terraform, Azure Pipelines, AKS, and Helm Charts, supporting cloud-native applications and hybrid infrastructure connectivity. Brings hands-on depth in Azure networking, identity, compute, storage, Linux administration, and observability with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Prometheus, and Grafana. Automates operations with PowerShell, Bash, and Python and collaborates with distributed development, security, and operations teams to troubleshoot incidents and deliver controlled releases.
